answer.reason: The ticket mandates a pure refactor with no change to what r1 announces, but replacing 'network 192.168.1.0/24' with unqualified 'redistribute connected' also advertises the connected /30 link subnets (10.0.12.0/30, 10.0.13.0/30) to r2 and r3. Netdryrun's checks pass only because they don't assert the absence of these extra prefixes; the author should add a route-map/prefix-list to redistribute only 192.168.1.0/24.
